description: Detect cluster buying for a company: periods where 3+ distinct insiders bought shares (Form 4 open-market purchases, code P) within a 14-day window, over a lookback of 7, 30 or 90 days (default 90). Returns clusterBuyingDetected, the strongest clusterWindow, a summary (totalValue is null when no purchase disclosed a price, and is a floor when unpricedPurchaseCount > 0) and the deduped purchases. `asOf` and `lookback` state the date range covered; clusterBuyingDetected false means none in that range only.

days.description: Lookback in days by transaction date: 7, 30 or 90 (default 90)

name: get_insider_cluster_buys
title: Get Insider Cluster Buys
